lines.zh: 我没有走过一步，是被抬进来的
lines.en: I have never taken a step, I was carried in

lines.zh: 长耳朵垂在肩膀上，一动不动
lines.en: Long ears hang at my shoulders, unmoving

lines.zh: 舞台上那块地板，是我站的地方
lines.en: That patch of stage is where I stand

lines.zh: 灰尘掉在我脚边，我没有挪
lines.en: Dust falls at my feet and I do not shift

lines.zh: 有人擦拭过我，又走开了
lines.en: Someone wiped me down and walked off

lines.zh: 我的鞋底是平的，从没抬起
lines.en: My soles are flat, they have never lifted

lines.zh: 这不是脚步，是幕布在动
lines.en: That is not footsteps, it is the curtain

lines.zh: 我站在这排人的中间
lines.en: I stand in the middle of this row

lines.zh: 灯一暗，我的颜色就沉下去
lines.en: When the lights dim, my color sinks

lines.zh: 三十年了，我还在原位
lines.en: Thirty years, and I am still in place

lines.zh: 我以为会有人来开灯
lines.en: I thought someone would come turn on the lights

lines.zh: 台边那两个空位，一直空着
lines.en: Those two empty spots by the stage stay empty

lines.zh: 我垂着手，站在台上
lines.en: I stand on the stage with my hands hanging

lines.zh: 耳朵的绒毛已经磨秃了
lines.en: The fuzz on my ears has worn bare

lines.zh: 绒布里面是硬的
lines.en: Under the plush it is hard

lines.zh: 我不敢说是活着，可我在
lines.en: I will not claim to be alive, but I am here

lines.zh: 我面前的地板有我的影子
lines.en: My shadow lies on the floor in front of me

lines.zh: 有人给舞台换了灯泡
lines.en: Someone changed the stage bulbs

lines.zh: 我什么都没在等，除了开场
lines.en: I am waiting for nothing but the opening

lines.zh: 指甲套上有一道划痕
lines.en: There is a scratch on my finger casing

lines.zh: 灯光从侧面打过来，我的脸一半黑
lines.en: The sidelight leaves half my face in darkness

lines.zh: 我不呼吸，可空气在我身边动
lines.en: I do not breathe, yet the air moves around me

lines.zh: 乐队的位置空着，我在弹的位置上
lines.en: The band's spot is empty, and I am where the playing happens

lines.zh: 布的缝线松了一根
lines.en: One seam has come loose

lines.zh: 我知道门口有谁进来
lines.en: I know who comes through the door

lines.zh: 我对着观众席，一直对着
lines.en: I face the seats, and always have

lines.zh: 你站在观众席，我在台上
lines.en: You are in the seats, I am on the stage

lines.zh: 台子只有这么高，你不用仰太久
lines.en: The stage is low, you need not look up long

lines.zh: 我的耳朵比你整个人都长
lines.en: My ears are longer than you are tall

lines.zh: 你看着我，我其实在看门
lines.en: You look at me, I am really watching the door

lines.zh: 这张脸笑得很固定
lines.en: This smile is fixed in place

lines.zh: 你走上来，是想摸我的耳朵吗
lines.en: Coming up here to touch my ears?

lines.zh: 绒布下面的指节是铁的
lines.en: The knuckles under the plush are iron

lines.zh: 我在这儿站得比这栋楼还久
lines.en: I have stood here longer than this building

lines.zh: 你别指望我让开
lines.en: Do not expect me to step aside

lines.zh: 你身上的味道，和客人一样
lines.en: You smell like a customer

lines.zh: 我只有两种表情，现在这一种
lines.en: I have two expressions, this is the one

lines.zh: 你的影子挡住了我一半
lines.en: Your shadow covers half of me

lines.zh: 我们在同一盏灯下面
lines.en: We are under the same lamp

lines.zh: 你要说话，就说给我身后的墙
lines.en: Say it to the wall behind me if you like

lines.zh: 我看着你的鞋，你站得太近了
lines.en: I am looking at your shoes, you are too close

lines.zh: 这一排里，我的位置最靠门
lines.en: In this row, my spot is nearest the door

lines.zh: 你抬手的时候，我的耳朵晃了
lines.en: When you raised your hand, my ear swayed

lines.zh: 我什么都没做，你退了两步
lines.en: I did nothing and you took two steps back

lines.zh: 绒布破了，里面露出铁
lines.en: The plush split, iron shows through

lines.zh: 我歪了，还能站
lines.en: I am tilted, still standing

lines.zh: 那只耳朵掉下来了
lines.en: That ear came down

lines.zh: 我听见自己骨架的响
lines.en: I heard my own frame rattle

lines.zh: 我站了这么多年，没挨过打
lines.en: All these years standing here, never struck

lines.zh: 灰抖了一地都是
lines.en: Dust shook out all across the floor

lines.zh: 脸上的笑歪了一边
lines.en: The smile is crooked on one side

lines.zh: 你给我留了一道口子
lines.en: You left me a gash

lines.zh: 我还在原位，只是难看
lines.en: I am still in place, only uglier

lines.zh: 这一下，台下的位置震了
lines.en: That shook the seats below

lines.zh: 我不吃，缝线是封死的
lines.en: I do not eat, the stitching is sealed

lines.zh: 你给台上的人递吃的
lines.en: You are offering food to someone on stage

lines.zh: 食物在灯下放久了会坏
lines.en: Food left under the lights will spoil

lines.zh: 我连低头都做不到
lines.en: I cannot even lower my head

lines.zh: 这块布上没有嘴的功能
lines.en: This cloth has no mouth to speak of

lines.zh: 你以为台上的会伸手接
lines.en: You think the one on stage will reach for it

lines.zh: 放下吧，我记住了位置
lines.en: Set it down, I have noted the place

lines.zh: 这栋楼里没有厨房了
lines.en: There is no kitchen in this building anymore

lines.zh: 你手再往前，就碰到我的膝盖
lines.en: One more inch and you touch my knee

lines.zh: 拿稳，别洒在我脚边
lines.en: Hold it steady, do not spill it at my feet

lines.zh: 你撞上来，我先歪了耳朵
lines.en: You bumped me and my ears went first

lines.zh: 我晃了一下，脚没抬
lines.en: I rocked once, my feet did not lift

lines.zh: 这一下弄得绒布起了球
lines.en: That worked up fuzz on the plush

lines.zh: 我站得太久，底座有点松
lines.en: I have stood so long that my base is loose

lines.zh: 别推，这舞台上没有多余的位子
lines.en: Do not push, there is no spare room on this stage

lines.zh: 你退开的时候踩到了线缆
lines.en: You stepped on a cable as you backed off

lines.zh: 撞到我，谁的骨头响你清楚
lines.en: You hit me, you know whose bone cracked

lines.zh: 我还站着，位置没变
lines.en: I am still standing, my position unchanged

lines.zh: 你碰的是好几年的灰
lines.en: What you touched was years of dust

lines.zh: 下次再来，我可能就倒了
lines.en: Next time, I might be the one to fall

lines.zh: 我耳朵这么长，听得很清楚
lines.en: My ears are long, I hear you clearly

lines.zh: 你这句话，我一天听了三遍
lines.en: I have heard that line three times today

lines.zh: 台上只有位置，没有人
lines.en: There is only a position on this stage, no person

lines.zh: 你靠得太近，布会掉色
lines.en: You are too close, the dye will rub off

lines.zh: 我只是一个摆在那儿的形象
lines.en: I am only an image set in place

lines.zh: 两个孩子喜欢过我，那是很久以前
lines.en: Two children liked me once, long ago

lines.zh: 我的关节里没有温度
lines.en: There is no warmth in my joints

lines.zh: 你说的这些，台上不演
lines.en: We do not perform that on this stage

lines.zh: 灯光要灭了，请你回去坐好
lines.en: The lights are going, please return to your seat

lines.zh: 我好些年没说过这么多了
lines.en: I have not said this much in years

lines.zh: 东西掉在台上，我够不到
lines.en: It fell on the stage, I cannot reach it

lines.zh: 我的手指是一整块，弯不了
lines.en: My fingers are one solid piece, they cannot bend

lines.zh: 它滚到我鞋边就停了
lines.en: It rolled and stopped by my shoe

lines.zh: 你要拿就拿，别碰我的脚
lines.en: Take it, but do not touch my feet

lines.zh: 台上的东西，本来都归这里
lines.en: Things on this stage belong to this place

lines.zh: 我看着它很久了
lines.en: I have been looking at it a while

lines.zh: 它上面全是灰
lines.en: It is covered in dust

lines.zh: 你要是捡起来，也算替台上收拾
lines.en: If you pick it up, count it as tidying the stage

lines.zh: 我弯不下腰，这事一直是这样
lines.en: I cannot bend at the waist, that has always been so

lines.zh: 别把它踢到台下
lines.en: Do not kick it off the stage

lines.zh: 有人进了大厅，我听见了
lines.en: Someone entered the hall, I heard it

lines.zh: 我的耳朵朝门口转了
lines.en: My ears turned toward the door

lines.zh: 你走到台前，就进了我的视线
lines.en: Step up to the stage and you are in my sight

lines.zh: 这栋楼里的响动，我一个不漏
lines.en: No sound in this building escapes me

lines.zh: 我看着你，一点也不客气
lines.en: I watch you with no courtesy at all

lines.zh: 上一场的观众，没这么大胆
lines.en: The last audience was not this bold

lines.zh: 台子的高度，刚好让我看得清楚
lines.en: The stage height lets me see clearly

lines.zh: 你往哪儿走，都是我的正面
lines.en: Wherever you walk, you are in my front

lines.zh: 这地方该有个音乐响起来
lines.en: Some music ought to start in this place

lines.zh: 你听见了吗，幕布后面有声音
lines.en: Did you hear that, a sound behind the curtain

lines.zh: 我不动，可我知道你心跳快
lines.en: I do not move, yet I know your heart is fast

lines.zh: 门口那盏灯灭了
lines.en: The lamp at the door went out

lines.zh: 别站在暗的那半边
lines.en: Do not stand on the dark side

lines.zh: 今晚来的客人，只有你一个
lines.en: You are the only guest tonight

lines.zh: 你要么坐下，要么出去
lines.en: Either sit down or leave

lines.zh: 你还在大厅里，我知道
lines.en: You are still in the hall, I know

lines.zh: 我的头转不过去，可耳朵够用
lines.en: My head will not turn, my ears suffice

lines.zh: 这栋楼的地板，每一步都记得
lines.en: Every step on these floors is remembered

lines.zh: 你绕着台子走，我听得见三面
lines.en: Walk around the stage, I hear three sides

lines.zh: 灯管嗡嗡响，你没听见别的
lines.en: The tubes are humming, you hear nothing else

lines.zh: 我已经很久没这么专心了
lines.en: I have not been this attentive in a long time

lines.zh: 绒布上那点灰，落了又落
lines.en: The dust on the plush falls and falls

lines.zh: 你走近一步，灯就暗一分
lines.en: Each step you take, the light dims a little

lines.zh: 我的耳朵塌下来了一点
lines.en: My ears have drooped a little

lines.zh: 台上没有幕布可以躲
lines.en: There is no curtain to hide behind up here

lines.zh: 我一直在原位，你一直在绕
lines.en: I stay in place, you keep circling

lines.zh: 你回头看我的次数，我记下了
lines.en: I have counted how often you look back

lines.zh: 门在你身后，是关着的
lines.en: The door behind you is shut

lines.zh: 这个地方，安静得不该
lines.en: This place is quieter than it should be

lines.zh: 你听见的笑声，不是我发的
lines.en: That laugh you heard was not mine

lines.zh: 我的影子刚刚动了一下
lines.en: My shadow just moved

lines.zh: 你身边的那把椅子，空了
lines.en: That chair beside you is empty

lines.zh: 你说话的语调变了
lines.en: Your tone has changed

lines.zh: 我的手没抬，可你的肩上有了重量
lines.en: My hand did not rise, yet something weighs on your shoulder

lines.zh: 台边刮了你一下
lines.en: The stage edge scraped you

lines.zh: 你撞到我的腿，退了三步
lines.en: You hit my leg and fell back three paces

lines.zh: 这一下，绒布上沾了红
lines.en: Now there is red on the plush

lines.zh: 你靠得太近，我的鞋跟绊了你
lines.en: You came too close, my heel caught you

lines.zh: 我没有动手，是你在抖
lines.en: I did not move, you are the one shaking

lines.zh: 你退到台边，差点摔下去
lines.en: You backed to the stage edge and almost fell

lines.zh: 我的指头碰到你，是凉的
lines.en: My finger touched you, and it was cold

lines.zh: 你听见耳边有布摩擦的声音
lines.en: You hear cloth rubbing by your ear

lines.zh: 这一排人里，只有我动了
lines.en: In this row, only I moved

lines.zh: 你按着肩膀，往门口退
lines.en: You clutch your shoulder and back toward the door

lines.zh: 这一下很轻，够你记住
lines.en: Light as it was, it is enough to remember

lines.zh: 你的膝盖撞在台沿上
lines.en: Your knee struck the stage lip

lines.zh: 我把脸转向你，脖子响了一声
lines.en: I turn my face to you and my neck creaks

lines.zh: 你手上的东西掉了
lines.en: What was in your hand fell

lines.zh: 这间屋子里，我们俩离得最近
lines.en: In this room, we are the closest two

lines.zh: 台上本来就有一个位置
lines.en: There was always a spot on the stage

lines.zh: 幕布拉开的时候，我就在
lines.en: When the curtain opened, I was there

lines.zh: 我被抬上台，脚一落就定了
lines.en: I was carried up and my feet settled at once

lines.zh: 长耳朵的影子落在幕布上
lines.en: The shadow of long ears falls on the curtain

lines.zh: 这排人里，多了一个
lines.en: One has been added to this row

lines.zh: 灯光打开，先照到我
lines.en: The lights came on and hit me first

lines.zh: 地板被压得响了一声
lines.en: The floor creaked under the weight

lines.zh: 我是从旧箱子里搬出来的
lines.en: I was taken out of an old crate

lines.zh: 灰尘一抖，整间屋子都是
lines.en: One shake and dust fills the room

lines.zh: 这场戏，缺一个人
lines.en: This show was one short

lines.zh: 台上有了影子，就该有人了
lines.en: A shadow on the stage means someone is here

lines.zh: 绒布被抚平，摆正了
lines.en: The plush was smoothed and set straight

lines.zh: 门开了，灯亮了，我在台上
lines.en: Door open, lights on, and I am on the stage

lines.zh: 我站的地方，是老位置
lines.en: I stand where I have always stood

lines.zh: 有人说了句玩笑，然后走了
lines.en: Someone made a joke and left

lines.zh: 这一层的地板，多了个印子
lines.en: There is a new mark on this floor

lines.zh: 幕布后面有东西挪了一下
lines.en: Something shifted behind the curtain

lines.zh: 台上台下，隔着一层光
lines.en: Between the stage and the seats is a layer of light

lines.zh: 绒布烧起来，味道像旧屋
lines.en: The plush caught fire, smelling like an old attic

lines.zh: 我从台上摔下去，摔断了腿
lines.en: I fell off the stage and broke a leg

lines.zh: 水渗进来，绒布沉了
lines.en: Water seeped in and the plush turned heavy

lines.zh: 炸得我一只眼球脱了出来
lines.en: The blast knocked one eye loose

lines.zh: 一支箭钉在我的耳朵上
lines.en: An arrow is pinned through my ear

lines.zh: 一股力气钻进关节，关节自己转了
lines.en: Something entered my joints and they turned on their own

lines.zh: 我不会饿，可这身壳在散
lines.en: I do not hunger, yet this shell is coming apart

lines.zh: 雷光一闪，我的影子跳到了墙上
lines.en: A flash of lightning threw my shadow up the wall

lines.zh: 这里没有台子，我脚下空了
lines.en: There is no stage here, my feet find nothing
